During a war between the Pandavas and Kauravas, Ashnoor, disguised as a eunuch, entered the Pandava camp to spy on them. However, she was discovered and captured. Bhima, one of the Pandavas, was infatuated with her and decided to marry her. Even after revealing her true identity, Bhima did not abandon her. Instead, he granted her the kingdom of Vidharbha.

Ashnoor is also the name of a temple town in the Indian state of Maharashtra. It is believed that this place was once ruled by a queen named Ashnoor.
